player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Arwen Even*''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
description: ISB Operations on a Hoth platform, in conjunction with You May Start Your Landing.  Went undefeated in the Origins Open, has beaten just about any and every light decktype there is.

shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Posted 9 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card (Coruscant: Imperial Square is Special Edition), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
The description says the deck 'went undefeated in the Origins Open' (Origins, early July 2001); no place is given, so the finish is recorded as 'undefeated'.

Starting cards: the strategy names Coruscant: Imperial Square, Imperial Decree, Imperial Arrest Order and There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement, and the list marks Prepared Defenses '(start)'; with the Objective these count toward the 60.
'Combat Vehicles (5)' is a section header, not a card.
Posted 'There Is No Try/ Oppressive Enforcement' with '(start)' on the next line is one card, the combo There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement.

Hoth system and sites dested the Dark printings: Hoth (Dark), Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark), Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark); Frostbite and Ice Storm dested the Dark Hoth Effects.
Posted '5D6-RA7' dested 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix); 'Chall Beken' dested Chall Bekan.
Secret Plans, Resistance and No Escape are the 2001 Effects (Secret Plans is the Special Edition Effect, not the later Reflections III Defensive Shield).
Byline 'Kimberly Caton' is credited to the existing wiki player Kim Caton.
